verifiedUiAndNovicePrerequisites.definition: A labelled icon/tab restricts the list to an item family. Materials, Weapons and Food are actually selected in these samples.

Yellow outline selects the item being read; blue tile indicates equipped item. The avatar can keep the old equipped weapon while the cursor points to another item. Confirmed equipment change must be shown separately.
Item picture/name identify the object; the small crossed-sword number is displayed attack, not independently measured DPS.
Attach a material/object to currently equipped weapon, shield or arrow. The green target view is a pending selection; the completed weapon/arrow and subsequent effect are the result.
Nintendo says removing a fused material through the equipment menu destroys that material. Do not promise cost-free infinite reversal. This footage does not demonstrate removal.
Ordering items by a criterion is conceptually separate from changing category or dropping items. The actual Drop menus at1124/1126/1127 cause removal, not verified sorting.

equivalenceAndOrderLimits.backbonePreserved: Use these cases beside original roles04finding/category/icon/sort and06choice-test proximity, then return to the next retained point. Do not insert a new Zelda/Fuse technical chapter.
equivalenceAndOrderLimits.notOriginalSpecificHardware: This is a verified same-series substitute for the retained design role, not a claim the reference featured this exact game/version.
equivalenceAndOrderLimits.literalLoopLimit: The samples show choose/confirm -> use and material choice -> outcome. They do not demonstrate a complete repeat of the same reversible equipment cycle; use the original abstract loop to explain return-and-change, or a separately verified Splatoon cycle.
equivalenceAndOrderLimits.automaticEquipment: No auto-equipment system is claimed in Zelda; keep root self-authored criterion/candidate illustration.
equivalenceAndOrderLimits.workedDps: Keep A100 damage/2 seconds=50 and B40 damage/0.5 seconds=80 explicitly hypothetical and separate from commercial-game footage values.
equivalenceAndOrderLimits.noForcedLatest: Echoes of Wisdom is newer in the mainline series but official mechanics emphasise echoes and temporary Swordfighter form; it is not a verified equivalent equipment-category/weapon-Fuse demonstration. Nintendo Switch2Edition TOTK exists with performance/ZELDA NOTES enhancements, but this source identifies only Switch capture. Do not substitute or relabel solely for recency.
